title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Skyworth Group, a globally recognized smart home appliance and technology company founded in 1988, with business operations spanning over 100 countries and regions. The company offers a diverse portfolio including smart TVs, home appliances, smart systems, and new energy solutions. Our brand portfolio in North America includes Skyworth, Panasonic, and Philips. We are a rapidly growing team and loo...k forward to having you join us as we work together to advance the home appliance industry.
About the Role
Lead U.S. e-commerce and consumer electronics market analysis, develop a deep-growth Amazon strategy alongside multi-channel expansion plans, and drive the business from early-stage development to scalable growth.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead U.S. e-commerce and consumer electronics market analysis, develop a deep-growth Amazon strategy alongside multi-channel expansion plans, and drive the business from early-stage development to scalable growth. Optimize Amazon core operations including product listing, pricing strategy, inventory management, and performance enhancement, while spearheading research, onboarding, and expansion into new channels such as Walmart and other key platforms.
Develop and execute data-driven digital marketing strategies; define and monitor key performance indicators to achieve revenue and margin targets during the channel expansion phase. Build and scale a high-performing U.S. e-commerce team aligned with early-stage business needs, fostering a results-oriented and performance-driven culture. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and external platform partners to secure strategic resources for new channel expansion, ensuring full compliance across all operational activities.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Marketing, E-Commerce, or related fields. Minimum of 8 years of U.S. e-commerce experience, with at least 5 years in senior management roles within consumer electronics e-commerce.
Deep expertise in Amazon platform operations, with proven success in launching and scaling new North American e-commerce channels from 0 to 1. Demonstrated full P&L ownership experience, with a strong track record of driving revenue and GMV growth during early-stage expansion in the North American consumer electronics market. Strong leadership and team-building capabilities, excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, and fluency in English (written and verbal) with strong presentation and negotiation abilities.
In-depth knowledge of U.S. e-commerce regulations and platform policies; highly data-driven with established industry and platform relationships within the North American consumer electronics sector.

title: Systems Administrator
description:
Job Summary The System Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and support of the organization's IT infrastructure, including servers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, and related technologies. This position helps ensure the availability, reliability, and security of systems by performing routine maintenance, monitoring system and network perform...ance, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing approved changes.
The System
Administrator works closely with IT teams, vendors, and business users to resolve incidents, support technology initiatives, and maintain a stable computing environment. The position requires foundational system administration knowledge with the ability to manage assigned infrastructure tasks independently while following established procedures, security standards, and operational best practices, and provides technical support for escalated issues from service desk and end-user support teams.
Responsibilities
• Manage and maintain servers, operating systems, applications, storage systems, file shares, and related IT infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers.
• Administer Windows and Linux systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, Group Policy, user accounts, security groups, permissions, and access management.
• Manage and troubleshoot LAN/WAN and network infrastructure, including TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and network connectivity.
• Monitor system performance, availability, capacity, and network health and take appropriate corrective action when issues are identified.
• Manage backup configuration and monitoring, backup verification, file and system restoration, disaster recovery procedures, recovery testing, and business continuity documentation.
• Maintain system and endpoint security through security patching, antivirus and EDR management, access controls, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and support for security incidents.
• Support virtualization platforms, including VMware and Hyper-V.
• Support Microsoft 365 and cloud environments such as Azure and AWS, including cloud infrastructure, user and access administration, email and collaboration services, and business application infrastructure.
• Provide desktop and endpoint support for Windows workstations and laptops, including operating system configuration, software installation and troubleshooting, hardware troubleshooting, endpoint security, and patch management.
• Investigate and resolve system, network, and infrastructure incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
• Automate routine administrative tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting and automation tools as appropriate.
• Maintain accurate IT documentation, system configurations, procedures, infrastructure records, and operational documentation.
• Coordinate with vendors and service providers to resolve technical issues and support infrastructure needs and projects.
• Support IT projects, system upgrades, migrations, technology initiatives, and infrastructure improvements.
• Ensure assigned systems and activities comply with IT security policies, standards, and operational procedures.
• Support onboarding and offboarding activities related to system access, account administration, permissions, and technology setup as assigned.
• Perform other related IT duties as assigned based on business needs.
